218040.description:
Eat Or Die!

The first prince of the kingdom of Farune, Mars, is only twelve years old, yet he lives in fear of assassination. In order to avoid the deadly poison in nearly all of his meals, he slips out of the castle into the nearby monster-infested forest, where, battling monsters and his own hunger, he has to hunt for his meals in order to stave off starvation. Then, one night, as he’s searching for his next bite of monster meat, a red-haired woman shouldering a greatsword appears before him and says to him, “You have promise. Become my apprentice.” How is he supposed to tell her that this must be some sort of mistake? But there’s a secret that only she knows, and that he’s stumbled upon: eating monsters makes you stronger! With her training and his newfound power, Mars will finally overcome all those pesky assassination attempts. However, that doesn’t end things; no, it’s only the beginning of a nationwide—even continent-spanning—series of wars and plots with him right in the middle!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)
synonyms: How I Became King by Eating Monsters

218771.description:
"Oh, for heaven's sake... I suppose I have no choice..."

Though exasperated, Manami crouches down before Yuito—who sits hunched over, looking dejected—and reaches out toward his fully erect, straining member. She has ended up in an intimate relationship with Yuito, her own daughter’s boyfriend... Even as her mind tells her she must stop, her body—flushed with heat in his embrace—proves impossible to resist. Silently apologizing to her daughter in her heart, Manami moves rhythmically atop Yuito, fully embodying the essence of a woman in the throes of desire...

"Just this once, mind you..."

The words she has uttered time and again dissolve into nothingness the moment she is pulled into his tight embrace. Stunned by how easily she gives in—a fact that leaves even her own self bewildered—Manami finds herself, once again today, clinging to Yuito and crying out in pleasure...

(Source: Getchu, translated)

218798.description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by RPG Nukuuru Koubou (RPGヌクール工房).

A dungeon suddenly appeared in a small, remote village. If the monsters within were to escape, the village would be destroyed. Just as the villagers were sinking into despair, an adventurer arrived—a sage named Time, an expert in magic.

"Please, Sage! You must protect our village!"

However, this was a "pink dungeon"—a place inhabited exclusively by female-type monsters. For Time, the sage, this was the worst possible scenario: becoming sexually aroused would cause his powers to weaken. Though he felt terrible about it, he tried to decline... but the married women of the village stepped forward, offering to help manage his sexual urges so he could clear the dungeon! Devoting themselves to the cause of saving their village, these married women reveal the full extent of their charms. Their service only escalates, eventually crossing the line...

A sage who grows weaker the moment he becomes aroused—now heading into a "pink dungeon," a den of female-type monsters!? The key to saving the village lies in the ultimate, boundary-pushing support provided by these married women!

(Source: Getchu, translated)
synonyms: Kenja Taimu no Sukkiri Hitozuma Bouken-ki!
